text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm working as usual when Super Creek
excitedly
places a flyer on my desk.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's for a free one-day pottery class.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They're holding an event at the art
museum. It
looks like you get to make
your own bowls and
teacups.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't it sound like a lot of fun? Why
don't you
come with me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Great! Since I don't have anything else
to do
today, let's get going! ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: What are you thinking of making?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Gosh! Hehe, I wonder if you can really
make
something like that out of clay...
choice_data_list: トレーニングに使えるものとか？

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You've always got training on your mind,
haven't
you?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I absolutely adore how dedicated you
are.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, good question. A teacup or a vase
might
be nice...
choice_data_list: クリークは何を作るんだ？
クリークは何を作るの？

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But you have to carefully consider the
thickness
of things like teacups, or they
might end up being
too heavy to use...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And vases are big, so you have to take
your time
or you might ruin them.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Which do you think is better?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Then a teacup it is!
choice_data_list: 湯呑は使い勝手がよさそう
インテリアになりそうな花瓶かな

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hehe, I hope I do a good job! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try my hand at pottery with Super
Creek. We
can't come up with anything
that would be useful
for training, so we
both end up making teacups.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was pretty hard work,
wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Having a knack for it is important, but
making
pottery actually uses more brain
power than I
expected.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It won't turn out the way you want it to if
you let
your mind wander.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But watching it slowly take shape, a
deep feeling
of attachment grew inside
me...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: As if it were my own child.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Me neither! ♪
choice_data_list: 焼けて完成するのが楽しみだ
焼けて完成するのが楽しみだね

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um... Would you like to exchange
teacups once
they're done?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I actually made a wish on my teacup
while I was
making it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I wished for all the tea you drink out of
it to be
delicious and relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was. You're always working hard, so I
wanted to
give you some comfort.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I'll always be here to make you feel
better
with more than just a cup of tea!
Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Several days later, Super Creek and I
enjoy some
tea after exchanging our
teacups.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's learned something
valuable
from the pottery class.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It will be difficult, but trying hard is an
experience
in and of itself!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Let's keep giving it our all! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I try my hand at pottery with Super
Creek. We
can't come up with anything
that would be useful
for training, so we
both end up making vases.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Great job. Did you enjoy yourself?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It sure was. I loved watching how
focused you
were. So cute. ♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But the whole process involved more
detail and
patience than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just about gently pressing the
clay with
your hands. There was a lot
more to it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I think it was a truly valuable experience.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Me neither! We should go find some
flowers to
put in them once they're
done.
choice_data_list: 焼きあがるのが楽しみだ
焼きあがるのが楽しみだね

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
It would be lovely to decorate our own
rooms
with the same flowers.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That way, we'll think of today whenever
we look
at them and remember the fun
we had! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Super Creek and I
head out to
look for flowers to put in
our finished vases.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems like she's learned something
valuable
from the pottery class.
